title: Bufalin: A promising therapeutic drug against the cisplatin-resistance of ovarian cancer by targeting the USP36/c-Myc axis.
authors: Li, Bing; Tan, Shu; Yu, Xi; Wang, Yan
one_liner_zh: 研究蟾蜍灵通过USP36/c-Myc轴逆转卵巢癌顺铂耐药，仅涉及药物-蛋白分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cisplatin (DPP) resistance is a severe obstacle to ovarian cancer (OC) treatment. Our research aims to uncover the therapeutic effect and the underlying mechanism of Bufalin against DDP resistance. The cell viability, proliferation capacity, gammaH2AX expression, and apoptosis ratio were quantified via CCK8 assay, colony formation assay, immunofluorescence, and flow cytometry analysis respectively. Xenografting experiment was performed to detect the tumor growth. Molecular docking was applied to mimic the combination of Bufalin and USP36 protein, and Western blotting was conducted to measure the Bax, Bcl-2, gammaH2AX, USP36, and c-Myc expression. The c-Myc ubiquitination and half-life were detected via ubiquitination assay and cycloheximide chasing assay. Bufalin treatment notably suppressed the cell viability and colony numbers, and increased the apoptosis ratio and gammaH2AX level in the DDP treatment group. Bufalin therapy also notably inhibited tumor growth, Bax, Bcl-2, and gammaH2AX expression in vivo. Moreover, the Bufalin application remarkedly reduced the c-Myc expression and half-life and increased the c-Myc ubiquitination via interaction and subsequent down-regulation of USP36. Knockdown of USP36 reversed the antiproliferative effect and proapoptotic capacity of Bufalin therapy in the DDP treatment group. In conclusion, Bufalin can overcome the DDP resistance in vitro and in vivo via the USP36/c-Myc axis, which innovatively suggests the therapeutic potential of Bufalin against DDP resistance ovarian cancer.
abstract_zh: 顺铂（DDP）耐药是卵巢癌（OC）治疗中的严重障碍。本研究旨在揭示蟾毒灵（Bufalin）对抗DDP耐药的治疗效果及其潜在机制。通过CCK8实验、集落形成实验、免疫荧光和流式细胞术分别量化了细胞活力、增殖能力、γH2AX表达和凋亡率。采用异种移植实验检测肿瘤生长情况。运用分子对接模拟蟾毒灵与USP36蛋白的结合，并通过Western blotting检测Bax、Bcl-2、γH2AX、USP36和c-Myc的表达。通过泛素化实验和放线菌酮追踪实验检测c-Myc的泛素化及其半衰期。蟾毒灵处理显著抑制了DDP处理组的细胞活力和集落数量，并增加了凋亡率和γH2AX水平。蟾毒灵治疗在体内也显著抑制了肿瘤生长以及Bax、Bcl-2和γH2AX的表达。此外，蟾毒灵的应用通过相互作用及随后下调USP36，显著降低了c-Myc的表达和半衰期，并增加了c-Myc的泛素化。敲低USP36逆转了蟾毒灵治疗在DDP处理组中的抗增殖效应和促凋亡能力。总之，蟾毒灵通过USP36/c-Myc轴在体外和体内克服了DDP耐药，这创新性地提示了蟾毒灵对抗DDP耐药卵巢癌的治疗潜力。
